name: @intellectual-frontiers/package-managers
description: The shared kit of the dialects that drive a package manager for Archon and Toolchain: the commands of the packaging ontology as argument vectors (no shell), the exact version written as each manager writes it, the jobs a tool asks of a manager, the plan file, the observation of what is installed, and the dialect made from a manager's data.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
